compiled_state.title: T2: RED — Write integration test for brainstorm-emit to preplanning-consume PIL path
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-pil-handoff-integration.sh that validates the full brainstorm-emit -> preplanning-consume PIL path. Tests must fail before T3 wires the validation logic.

## Test Cases
1. Sample PIL JSON with all required fields -> preplanning context load succeeds -> exits 0
2. PIL JSON with missing required field -> preplanning context load exits 1 (validation error)
3. PIL JSON field mutated after brainstorm (immutable field changed) -> detection exits 1
4. PIL JSON with schema_version mismatch -> exits 1 with version error

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-pil-handoff-integration.sh exits non-zero (RED - validation not yet wired)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-pil-handoff-integration.sh

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S8B/T1 for schema definition)
